title: Abid ne yahi kehke ghurbat me guzara hai
body:
ABID NE YEHI KEHKE GHURBAT MEIN GUZARA HAI
Abbas agar hote ye puchta ammu se
Kisne mere baba ka sar tan se utara hai
<<MINI>>
Islam bachane ko har zulm gawara hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Naize pe chada dekha Abid ne sar-e-sarwar
Hasrat se kaha baba kya haal tumhara hai
<<MINI>>
Islam bachane ko har zulm gawara hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dushman ko bhi hairat thi Sajjad ki halat par
Chalees baras kaise ro ro ke guzara hai
<<MINI>>
Islam bachane ko har zulm gawara hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Na touq ka kuch gham hai na paon ke chalon ka
Dukh ye hai laee’n chadar Zainab ki utara hai
<<MINI>>
Islam bachane ko har zulm gawara hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kis tarha bhulaonga mein darbar ka wo manzar
Jab balwe mein hakim ne phupiyon ko pukara hai
<<MINI>>
Islam bachane ko har zulm gawara hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim hai na Akber hai Abbas na Asghar hai
Abid ne kaha ro kar ab koun hamhara hai
<<MINI>>
Islam bachane ko har zulm gawara hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas likho kaise Sajjad ki ghurbat ko
Khasta hai lahad jis ki saaya na sahara hai
<<MINI>>
Islam bachane ko har zulm gawara hai
